name: Woolly Pride: an Ealdfrost Yak's spell-click stays feedable again after the 60 s cooldown (#10028 #10122)
contract: Issue #10028 #10122. The Ealdfrost Yak 164420's smart_scripts chain cleared its SPELLCLICK npcflag on feed and
relied on a linked SMART_ACTION_CREATE_TIMED_EVENT (id 2) to restore it 60 s later, but that row's max delay
param was missing (defaulted to 0 < min 60000), so SmartAIMgr::IsMinMaxValid dropped the whole action at load
and the timer never fired. Expected: feeding a yak clears its spell-click prompt, and after the 60 s cooldown
it becomes feedable again (and credits the quest objective a second time), instead of staying permanently

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the yaks are
Let the yak reach the client
SETUP: the yak can be clicked
Feed the yak the first time
the yak is no longer clickable right after feeding
Wait past the 60 s restore timer
the yak is feedable again after the cooldown
Feed the same yak a second time
